value.title: Copilot footer hints are not provenance

sections.name: body
sections.value: PR #252 at c6a05846a4bd7f7af65ad08a7ab76d55dc53ea40: a literal quoted hint row can match the footer helper; safety additionally depends on a caret-aligned composer, fresh empty-composer read under owned input, and the separate settled-idle control gate. The F210 visual brake recognizes a column-zero ○ in either of the two rows before the box, regardless of wording; it does not recognize ●. Fuller captured dialog/sidebar/alternate-glyph coverage is a nonblocking C34 proof follow-up, not a demonstrated exploit. Do not equate exact footer segments with authenticated source provenance. Fixture geometry can be checked without retrieving private originals; disclose that this is not original-capture equivalence proof. CI artifact 14491889852 from successful job 135296931821 on run 44445612065 records all 31 composer tests passing. Review harness magicWand: require evidence-bearing clean delegated verdicts, including exact head, scope, citations and validation provenance. Difficulty DL-001: a one-line delegated result had no evidence and sync review agents could not accept an evidence follow-up; direct static inspection plus exact-head CI JUnit resolved the review without local builds/tests.
